usage: 星期六 is used to talk about the specific day Saturday in a week.
It can be the subject or object in a sentence when referring to plans, events, or feelings about Saturday.
You can combine 星期六 with time expressions to specify when something happens, for example, 星期六下午 (Saturday afternoon).
It often appears in sentences about weekly routines or activities.
星期六 can be used with modal verbs to express intentions or possibilities related to Saturday.
